findings.detail: --no-archive-codex-runs is diagnostic only; strict packaging cannot proceed with active stale Codex-run artifacts.
Context/audit package manifest must include command-run evidence (commands_run.log, commands_run.receipts.jsonl, COMMAND_RECEIPTS.jsonl, COMMAND_EXECUTION_RECEIPTS.jsonl, or *_COMMANDS_RUN.md).
Strict packaging cannot proceed while root package artifacts remain active.
